meta.name: explore-run
meta.description: Rigor Improve / Rigor Explore run leaf skill for bounded exploratory evidence in deep learning research repositories. Use when the researcher explicitly authorizes exploratory runs such as small-subset validation, short-cycle guess-and-check, batch sweeps, idle-GPU search, or quick transfer-learning trials, with fair-comparison caveats and no-overclaim summaries in `explore_outputs/`. Do not use for end-to-end exploration orchestration on top of `current_research`, trusted baseline execution, conservative training verification, default routing, verified SOTA claims, or implicit experimentation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在深度学习项目里小范围试跑模型,产出带公平比较提醒的实验摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有深度学习项目,想先小范围试跑再决定方向
copy.tagline_en: Run small exploratory training trials and get fair-comparison summaries
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a deep learning repo and want quick bounded trials

howto.what: 授权探索后,它规划小规模子集验证、短周期试跑等探索性实验,并在 explore_outputs/ 下写出变更集、可比性报告与候选运行排名。
howto.when: 当研究者明确授权探索性运行时接管,例如小规模子集验证、短周期试跑、批量扫描等;未获授权或需可信训练时不适用。

say.text: 帮我规划一批小规模子集验证的候选运行,并按成本排序
用 selection_weights 把成功率的权重调高,重新排候选
say.note: 按新权重重算候选排序

say.text: 评估这批探索结果的可比性,并写进可比性报告

howto.what_en: After you explicitly authorize exploration, it plans bounded small-subset and short-cycle runs and writes a changeset, comparability report, top-run ranking and status file under explore_outputs/.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the researcher explicitly authorizes exploratory runs, such as small-subset validation, short-cycle probes or batch sweeps. Not for trusted training or unapproved experimentation.

say_en.text: Plan a batch of small-subset validation candidates and rank them by cost
Raise the success_rate weight in selection_weights and re-rank the candidates
Assess how comparable these exploratory runs are and write the report
